died.name: Ludwig von Benedek
died.last_words: Relieved to hear that you feel better. I had a very bad night-am now stronger. Your poor Louis.

died.name: Hart Crane
died.cause: prior to jumping off a cruise ship

died.name: Edward R. Murrow
died.desc: American broadcast journalist and war correspondent
died.cause: patting the hand of his wife, Janet Huntington Brewster
died.last_words: Well, Jan, we were lucky at that.

died.name: Lou Everett
died.cause: prior to failed ejection from Ryan XV-5 Vertifan

died.name: Nicolas Jaeger
died.cause: prior to disappearing on Lhotse Shar in Nepal
died.last_words: When you've been in the mountains for many years, you may forget that it's not a man's world. Every day I have to remember that this is not a world for man. This is the only sure way to approach it. Otherwise it's like when a boxer lets his guard down, it can stop very quickly.

born.name: Mary Wollstonecraft
born.cause: to her husband, William Godwin, while dying from the effects of giving birth to Mary Shelley
born.last_words: I know what you are thinking of, but I have nothing to communicate on the subject of religion.

born.name: Ulysses S. Grant
born.cause: when asked if he wanted anything while dying of throat cancer

born.name: Maurice Baring
born.cause: when asked what he wanted for lunch
born.last_words: Whatever you would like me to have.

born.name: Richard Corfield
born.cause: killed in action at the Battle of Dul Madoba

born.name: Pete Ham
born.cause: written on a suicide note before hanging himself
born.last_words: Anne, I love you. Blair, I love you. I will not be allowed to love and trust everybody. This is better. Pete. P.S. Stan Polley is a soulless bastard. I will take him with me.
